title: DCP Anchor-Conditioned Adaptive Syndrome Routing and Coset-Gauge Invariance Bridge
claims: Under disjoint mod-2 kernel compression, shifting the coset representative x_0 = tilde_y_syn xor V w flips effective columns by (-1)^{w_j} mod 2^t and leaves tilde_A_j(x_0) mod 4 strictly invariant across all 2^m coset representatives.

Single-wire (m=1) secret-independent unitaries U(y_syn) preserve conditional Helstrom distance, whereas m = n + 1 disjoint mod-2 kernel wires enable adaptive Stage-2 CNOT routing w(y_syn) in ker((tilde_A(y_syn) mod 4)/2) across 100% of syndromes.
